subject.title: Add scoped-weekly (Fable) percentage as a menu-bar layout token

question: Should the new token remain model-neutral across all Claude scoped-weekly promotions, or should it dynamically identify the selected model?
rationale: The implementation intentionally supports any future scoped model window, while the proposed static Fable branding would become inaccurate once the provider rotates the promotion; choosing the durable user-facing contract requires product intent.

options.title: Use a neutral scoped token
options.body: Rename the palette, visible prefix, and accessibility wording to describe a generic scoped-weekly quota, preserving the current generic resolver.

options.title: Show the selected model dynamically
options.body: Extend render data to carry the selected scoped window title or model name so the menu bar identifies the actual active carve-out.

options.title: Ship Fable-only branding
options.body: Constrain the resolver and documentation to Fable-only behavior, accepting that later scoped promotions will not use this token.

recommendation.title: Use a neutral scoped token
recommendation.body: Rename the palette, visible prefix, and accessibility wording to describe a generic scoped-weekly quota, preserving the current generic resolver.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged provider parsing work defines the model-neutral scoped-window contract that the menu-bar token should represent.
